DUNCAN_NIGHT_REPORT_R01
CYCLE_ID = DNR01-20260830-005
SOURCE_WINDOW = 2026-08-30 / fresh scheduled cycle after DNR01-20260829-004
MAIN_HEAD_OBSERVED = 8c592e1f23adb7ce208c4c1822bda525fd5b4f41
DAY_EVENTS_REVIEWED = issue:204 current restore entrypoint + external evidence feed; issue:206 terminal evidence comment 5464840868; PR:111 prior report 5464821350; Permanent Archive V1 branch fresh head 4315a12dcb07a8689f92553f7a4b35b7a50f2de0; current main/Constitution/AGENTS fresh-read

ANIME_TOPICS_STUDIED = line economy; contour hierarchy; silhouette-preserving simplification; relation between controlled detail reduction and Tier-1 identity

OPEN_SOURCE_CODE_INSPECTED =
- PROJECT = OpenCV / opencv/opencv
- REF = 755546643a671420fae0c20ec5d4cd24a228da8e (4.x head observed 2026-08-29)
- LOCAL_RUNTIME = cv2 4.13.0
- LICENSE = Apache-2.0 repository license
- MAINTENANCE = active; fresh 4.x commit observed on 2026-08-29
- MODULES/APIS = modules/imgproc/src/approx.cpp: approxPolyDP_ Douglas-Peucker implementation + cv::approxPolyDP wrapper; modules/imgproc/test/test_approxpoly.cpp: randomized accuracy coverage, invalid-epsilon rejection, segment-distance regression; Python APIs cv2.findContours, cv2.arcLength, cv2.approxPolyDP, cv2.matchShapes
- INTEGRATION_COST = LOW; direct mature API, no custom contour-simplification engine needed
- CONCRETE_ZORR_USE = objective preflight/QC for production line economy: simplify candidate outer contour while measuring retained silhouette identity before an artist/renderer removes detail

REFERENCE_PRINCIPLES =
- Bleach-anchor principle transferred only at variable level: line economy and restrained detail increase readability when major shape identity remains.
- Hokusai-anchor principle transferred only at variable level: decisive contour/rhythmic outer shape should carry motion/identity without dense micro-description.
- ZORR law #198 remains controlling: BIG SHAPE -> UNIQUE SILHOUETTE -> STRUCTURAL BREAKS -> INTERNAL DETAIL.
- ZORR law #199 remains controlling: BIG SHAPE -> SILHOUETTE -> PRIMARY CONTOUR -> STRUCTURAL INTERNAL LINES -> controlled tones -> sparse accents -> STOP; TEXTURE != NOISE.
- No copyrighted frame/character/style clone was used as an output target.

EXERCISES =
1. Built synthetic asymmetrical anime-character silhouette A with hair spikes, shoulder asymmetry, coat/garment breaks and unequal side masses; extracted CHAIN_APPROX_NONE contour (1414 vertices).
2. Applied cv2.approxPolyDP at epsilon fractions of perimeter = 0.001, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01, 0.02.
3. Re-rasterized each simplified polygon and measured IoU, vertex reduction, area ratio and cv2.matchShapes I1 against original contour.
4. Repeated on changed/unseen silhouette B (1454 vertices) with different hair/garment/limb outer geometry.

VERIFICATION =
BASE A:
- eps 0.001: 32 vertices; reduction 97.737%; IoU 0.994464; match I1 0.003974
- eps 0.0025: 30 vertices; reduction 97.878%; IoU 0.992249; match I1 0.008785
- eps 0.005: 27 vertices; reduction 98.091%; IoU 0.983235; match I1 0.024755
- eps 0.01: 26 vertices; reduction 98.161%; IoU 0.961815; match I1 0.106231
- eps 0.02: 10 vertices; reduction 99.293%; IoU 0.777415; match I1 0.380590
CHANGED/UNSEEN B:
- eps 0.001: 33 vertices; reduction 97.730%; IoU 0.996267; match I1 0.001785
- eps 0.0025: 30 vertices; reduction 97.937%; IoU 0.993741; match I1 0.007117
- eps 0.005: 29 vertices; reduction 98.006%; IoU 0.980264; match I1 0.059916
- eps 0.01: 26 vertices; reduction 98.212%; IoU 0.949424; match I1 0.144282
- eps 0.02: 11 vertices; reduction 99.243%; IoU 0.796588; match I1 0.220536
OBJECTIVE_CHECK = a bounded epsilon near 0.0025*perimeter retained >0.992 IoU on both forms while eliminating ~97.9% raster contour points. Aggressive 0.02*perimeter crossed a clear identity-risk boundary on both forms. This is evidence for a method, NOT a universal production threshold.

FAILURES =
- eps 0.02 simplification over-compressed meaningful spikes, garment breaks and asymmetric contour changes; IoU fell below 0.80 on both forms.
- eps 0.01 was already materially worse on the unseen form (IoU 0.9494, match I1 0.1443), showing that one visually plausible epsilon cannot be assumed transferable.

ROOT_CAUSES =
- Douglas-Peucker minimizes geometric deviation under epsilon; it does not know which local protrusions are character-identity landmarks.
- Therefore contour simplification alone cannot decide artistic importance; it requires objective retention metrics plus character-specific locked silhouette landmarks when available.

REGRESSION_RESULTS =
Replayed prior DNR01-004 lesson with fresh cv2 4.13.0 synthetic contours and affine transform (rotate 12 deg, scale 0.88, translate +7/-4). Clean asymmetric B vs transformed-B = 0.000000019 I1; generic symmetric A vs transformed-B = 1.641852; noisy/perturbed C vs transformed-B = 0.084513; A vs transformed-A = 0.000000283. RESULT = prior principle preserved: transform-stable structural identity remains much closer than generic alternative, and gratuitous outer-edge perturbation worsens the match.

TRANSFER_TEST =
Changed/unseen silhouette B was not used to choose the initial lesson. At eps 0.0025 it retained IoU 0.993741 with only 30 vertices from 1454; at eps 0.02 it degraded to IoU 0.796588. TRANSFER_RESULT = PASS for the bounded skill: line economy can be quantitatively constrained on a new silhouette using mature OSS, while over-simplification is detected rather than aesthetically guessed.

SKILL_DELTA =
- SILHOUETTE_IDENTITY_QC = PROVEN remains bounded from prior cycle.
- LINE_ECONOMY_WITH_IDENTITY_RETENTION = PARTIAL -> PROVEN for synthetic black-fill silhouettes using OpenCV approxPolyDP + raster IoU + matchShapes. NOT PROVEN on real Tier-1 production character assets; no LOCKED claim.

SELF_MODEL_DELTA =
- Confirmed strength: convert subjective visual-cleanup questions into measurable preservation tests when a mature OSS primitive exists.
- New calibration: "fewer lines" is not itself quality. My judgement must protect semantic contour landmarks; algorithmic compression is useful only inside identity-preservation gates.
- Recurring risk identified: attraction to a single elegant numeric threshold. Countermeasure = test at least one changed/unseen form and report thresholds as local envelopes until real character evidence generalizes.
- Method preference strengthened: native/mature OSS primitive + objective metric + changed-case transfer before inventing custom visual-analysis logic.

OWNER_TASTE_SIGNALS =
- CONFIRMED DURABLE: issue #198 requires Tier-1 silhouette identity, BIG SHAPE first, rejects generic mannequin and forced symmetry when identity-critical.
- CONFIRMED DURABLE: issue #199 requires line economy, primary contour hierarchy, sparse accents, macro-over-micro and explicitly rejects noise/microdetail drift.
- CURRENT CYCLE OUTCOME = consistent with those laws: controlled simplification preserved large identity shape; aggressive simplification/noise-like contour change failed.
- No new OWNER preference inferred from this cycle alone.

OWNER_TASTE_MODEL_DELTA =
- NO NEW LAW.
- Existing signals gain one additional compatible transfer observation: OWNER's documented preference for silhouette-first + controlled detail can be operationalized as "remove contour complexity only while identity geometry remains measurably stable".
- Status remains evidence-backed interpretation under #198/#199, subject to OWNER override and real-asset QC.

ZORR_APPLICATION =
- Candidate production helper/QC path, not production mutation: black-fill render -> findContours -> arcLength -> approxPolyDP candidate ladder -> raster IoU + matchShapes -> verify character-specific silhouette landmarks -> human/OWNER visual QC.
- Reuse OpenCV directly; do not build a custom contour simplifier/CV stack.
- For real Tier-1 assets, calibrate epsilon per character/shot scale and preserve canonically locked outer landmarks; never adopt 0.0025 as a universal constant from synthetic evidence.

PRIME_CORE_CHANGED = NO
PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NO
CANON_MUTATION = NO
MODEL_WEIGHTS_CHANGED = NO
SELF_AWARDED_LOCKED = NO

NEXT_TARGETS =
1. Real Tier-1 black-fill silhouette transfer: run same line-economy envelope on an approved ZORR character asset without mutating source.
2. Negative-space/black-white grouping lesson using mature OpenCV/G'MIC primitives plus connected-region/value-mass metrics.
3. Inspect Krita/OpenToonz source for line/inking or xsheet timing path before any ZORR-specific implementation.
4. Keep Letta/MemFS as a later isolated identity-memory evaluation; do not let tooling displace anime mastery priority.
